formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Once anyone submits the signature to Quick.permit before the deadline, the signer's (owner's) QUICK allowance for the spender is set to exactly `value`. This replaces any earlier allowance.
If `value` is 2^256-1, the allowance becomes uint96 max. transferFrom never reduces that allowance, so it is unlimited.
The signer's permit nonce goes up by one, which makes any other signature with the same nonce unusable.
No tokens move when the permit is used. The spender can later move up to `value` QUICK from the owner with transferFrom.
formats.shown: The intent 'Authorize spending of tokens' shows the spender address (raw), the max amount in QUICK (2^255 and above shows as 'Unlimited'), the deadline as a date and the owner.

findings.title: Permit test only covers a finite amount; the 'Unlimited' threshold path for uint(-1) is never tested.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json message.value = 2500000000000000000000, rendered '2500 QUICK'. descriptor value field has threshold 0x8000… and message 'Unlimited'. Quick.sol permit: `if (rawAmount == uint(-1)) { amount = uint96(-1); }`
findings.fix: Add a test case with value = 2^256-1 and expect 'Max spending amount: Unlimited'.

findings.title: Permit with value exactly 2^96-1 gives an unlimited allowance but shows as about 79.2 billion QUICK.
findings.evidence: Quick.sol transferFrom: `if (spender != src && spenderAllowance != uint96(-1)) { ... sub96 ... }`. A permit with rawAmount = 2^96-1 stores uint96(-1), which transferFrom never reduces. The descriptor threshold is 2^255, so this value shows as a number.
findings.fix: No single threshold can cover both 2^96-1 and 2^256-1, and amounts between them revert. The number shown is far above supply, so the practical effect is the same.

findings.title: Permit intent does not name the token or spender; the fields carry them.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent 'Authorize spending of tokens', interpolatedIntent null. The fields show 'Spender' and 'Max spending amount' '2500 QUICK'.
